_about: Machine-readable routing suggestions behind scripts/routing-card.py — the single authority for WHICH SEAT a job gets. Evidence and sources: model-matrix.md. 'settled' = the evidence clearly favors one seat: use it unless an allowed deviation reason applies. 'close' = reasonable seats differ by task: ask the user once per run (grouped, plain language) or, when unattended or told 'use your judgment', start from judgment_prior. Codex and Grok seats name a model LINE ('line'), never a pinned id: the card resolves each line to the newest id visible on this machine (scripts/model_lines.py), so a successor release is used automatically and a superseded one never is. Claude seats use harness aliases, which already track the newest model. Durable recon findings are promoted here; bump 'verified'.

never_request.gpt-reserve: reported Luna-class quota fallback pool (SECONDARY); not a seat to request
never_request.codex-auto-review: Codex's internal approval reviewer, not a worker seat
never_request.grok-*-build-fast (and other suffixed Gr: variants of a base model at a different price; only when the user asks for speed
never_request.superseded versions (e.g. gpt-6-sol once: an older release in a line the card resolved newer — never a seat

allowed_deviation_reasons: provider-down: the access check or a dispatch showed the seat unusable this session
consent: the seat's provider needs the user's consent and does not have it yet
context: the ticket exceeds the seat's context ceiling or crosses its price cliff
bar: the lead judges the seat cannot clear this ticket's quality bar (First Law) — name the specific risk; the record then tests the judgment
user: the user asked for a different seat (this session or in the prompt)
record: the performance record shows the seat failing on this task shape
tools: the ticket needs a tool or transport the seat lacks
task-fit: close-call rows only — a named strength of another listed option matters for this ticket
exempt: a behavior-exempt change needs no extra seat (review rows only)

premium_rule: Premium models are never assigned automatically: never a default, fallback, escalation, reviewer, verifier, scout or 'second opinion', and never offered as a routing option. They are used only if the user asks for one in THIS session and then says yes again to one confirmation that names the model and its cost. Approval lasts only for the session, is never carried into another session, and is never inferred from a pre-approval flag. A LEAD that is itself a premium model is fine; this rule governs dispatches.

evaluated._about: the newest release in each line when this file was verified; a newer id in the same line is that line's successor (used after one cheap ping); an id in an unknown line needs recon

premium_lines.codex:astra: Codex Astra line (gpt-6-astra and any later gpt-*-astra), ~5x Codex Sol's price per token
premium_lines.claude:fable: Claude Fable (alias fable, any claude-fable-* id), ~2.5x Opus's price per token
